Cause of the browser failures, in this change: the runners' windows are narrower than the local one, so the task area had no room for the rail, More held the whole rail's body, the spec's helper left More open, and this change had put More above the docked approval card, so the card's Allow could not be clicked. More is back under a docked card (the popover's order) and the helper opens More only where asked. Cause of the checkpoints failure, in this change: Undo all stood under the rail's body inside More and moved as the body filled, so a click was lost; the controls now stand first.
